headline: MPS Limited announces shareholders meeting via postal ballot
summary: MPS Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The filing initiates a formal voting process for shareholders on corporate matters. Such notices outline resolutions that require shareholder approval without holding a physical general meeting. Retail investors holding MPS Limited shares should review the specific agenda items in the ballot notice.
why_it_matters: Shareholders must review and vote on upcoming corporate resolutions.

headline: NIFTY Media index gains 2% in Muhurat trading led by Zee and MPS
hook: Special session sparks media sector rally
summary: The NIFTY Media index rose 2% during the special Muhurat trading session. Zee Entertainment, MPS, and Tips Music drove the gains for the sector. Muhurat trading marks the beginning of the Hindu calendar year Samvat 2081 on Indian stock exchanges. Retail investors in these media stocks saw positive portfolio action during the symbolic session.
whats_next: Regular trading resumes on the next business day
why_it_matters: Media stock holders see festive session gains.
winners_losers: Media stock holders gain / broader market neutral
